title: The Kryptos Sculpture Cipher
hook: What secret lies hidden in the CIA's Kryptos sculpture?
headline: The Uncracked Secret of Kryptos

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: In November 1990, artist Jim Sanborn installed Kryptos at CIA headquarters

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: The 1,800-character cipher contains four sections, three of which have been solved

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: The final section, known as K4, remains unsolved despite years of attempts

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: In 2023, a CIA analyst said a clue hints at a distant planet

end.line: What could the hidden planet reference really mean?

description: Explore the enduring mystery of the Kryptos sculpture and its unsolved cipher.
